# StudioSpace

> Peer-to-peer creative production studio marketplace connecting photographers, filmmakers, podcasters, musicians, and makers with independent hourly studios.

## Public Pages
- `/` — Home overview with hero showcase, top 6 featured studios, studio categories, and workflow.
- `/studios` — Full studio directory with category filtering, keyword search, sorting, and pagination.
- `/studios/{id}` — Studio details, equipment gallery, live confirmed time slots, creator reviews, and booking modal.
- `/how-it-works` — Step-by-step booking guide for creators, host onboarding flow, and scheduling FAQ.
- `/about` — Platform mission, host guarantee standards, and supported creative disciplines.
- `/login`, `/register` — Email/password and Google OAuth authentication powered by BetterAuth.

## Private Workspace Routes (Session-Protected via `src/proxy.ts`)
- `/dashboard` — Unified host and creator summary.
- `/add-studio` — Publish a new studio listing.
- `/my-listings`, `/studios/edit/{id}` — Manage and edit owned studios.
- `/my-bookings` — Manage outgoing reservations, host confirmations, and PDF invoice downloads.
- `/wishlist` — Saved studio bookmarks.

## Backend API Summary (`NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL`)
- `GET /health` — Service health check.
- `GET /api/studios/featured` — Top 6 featured studios.
- `GET /api/studios?category=&search=&sort=&page=&limit=` — Filterable, paginated studio directory.
- `GET /api/studios/:id` — Studio record with reviews and `confirmedSlots`.
- `POST /api/bookings` — Submit booking request (`409 Conflict` if overlapping a `Confirmed` slot).
- `PATCH /api/bookings/:id/status` — Host/guest status transitions (`Pending -> Confirmed | Cancelled`, `Confirmed -> Completed | Cancelled`).
- Authentication for mutations accepts HTTPOnly `studiospace_token` cookie or `Authorization: Bearer <BetterAuth JWT>`.
